description:
.github/workflows/site-inputs.yml picks parents from the 10 newest successful develop runs (`gh run list ... --limit 10`) inline in YAML with no tests. As of 2026-10-13 the deployed parent c660e615 (run 38216829987) is exactly the 10th entry. The next successful run pushes it out; a dispatch with parent_core_sha=c660e615 then fails with "no site-inputs bundle attested on parent", and no bundle can be built whose parity covers the deployed SHA.

Work: move parent resolution into a script with unit tests (precedent: scripts/scheduled_workflow_liveness.py and its tests, #2815), look up the dispatched parent's artifact by SHA rather than from a fixed window, and keep the fail-closed behaviour. site-inputs.yml and scripts/site_inputs.py are soundness paths, so oracle review applies. Item site-split-62 changes the adjacent certification step; deliver in order.
